name: Sanctions & coercion
summary: EU proposes 22nd Russia package on 23 Nov, cutting 60 more banks from SWIFT; states aim to agree it in December
state: The European Commission proposed the EU's 22nd Russia sanctions package on 23 Nov: 60 more Russian banks removed from SWIFT, curbs on crypto platforms, a ban on repairing Russian refineries, over 70 more shadow-fleet vessels and a sports ban (Euronews). Member states must approve it, with a deal targeted in December (Eunews). The US Treasury listed Hezbollah and IRGC-linked finance networks on 18 Nov. No major economy has been fully cut off from payment systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Russia, or shipping and finance linked to it, face wider restrictions once the package is adopted; UK businesses should check OFSI and FCDO sanctions guidance.
rubric_hit: Watch: major new package proposed (EU 22nd, 23 Nov, 60 more banks off SWIFT); no major economy wholly cut off from payment systems for Alert
